method: Review the lesson and metadata against registered Anthropic, DeepSeek and OpenAI provider documentation; inspect the historical measurement caveats; execute the complete local Python fence and run offline editorial-boundary assertions. No provider requests were made.

observations.trace: Scoped cache_control to Anthropic Messages API; documented that the current DeepSeek Anthropic compatibility endpoint ignores it; separated Anthropic, DeepSeek Chat and OpenAI cache usage semantics; marked archived DeepSeek cache observations as non-reproducible without raw responses; bounded agent history resubmission and the quadratic toy model to stateless assumptions; added tool-result freshness and read-time authorization checks.

limitations: No live provider request or current endpoint cache behavior was tested.
Archived 2026-09 and 2026-10 observations lack per-request raw responses and cannot be independently recomputed; their causal interpretation remains unknown.
No live billing calculation, cache hit-rate measurement, production tenant-isolation check, or end-to-end latency comparison was performed.
Offline assertions check documented boundaries and the local example output; they do not prove production runtime behavior.
